releaseNotes: Unbolded effect stat summary values and formatted separators as bullets with concise 'Stats:' label; removed default descriptors in favor of placeholder text; auto-removing modifiers when decremented to 0 ranks; full 'ALTERNATE #' sections for alternate effects containing complete configuration settings; official rules description popups for added extras, flaws, feats, and drawbacks names, and info 'ℹ️' popups for base and alternate effects.
